item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 09/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring generally fine and persistently very hot weather to southern China in the next couple of days. High temperatures may also trigger showers and thunderstorms. With the anticyclone aloft weakening, it will be cloudier with a few showers over the coast of Guangdong early next week. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to affect the coast of southern China midweek next week. The weather will become unsettled over the region.
